meta.siteTitle: MingAnji.ai — Truck monitoring and business management
meta.siteDescription: MingAnji.ai turns sensor and controller data from Tian'An trucks into maps, dashboards, reports and planning tools for field and office teams.
meta.homeTitle: Truck intelligence, from the field to the office
meta.featuresDescription: Truck and equipment monitoring, mapping, planning and exports, staff management and business dashboards — in one platform.

footer.description: MingAnji.ai turns the operating information collected by truck sensors and controllers into maps, dashboards and tools for planning and managing work.

hero.title: Every truck becomes a source of clear information.
hero.lead: Sensors and controllers on Tian'An trucks record where they are and what they do. MingAnji.ai turns that activity into maps, dashboards and plans your team can act on.

truck.title: A connected working truck
truck.body: Each Tian'An truck can be equipped with sensors and an onboard controller. Equipment varies by truck model and configuration.

sensors.title: Sensors record the work
sensors.body: Sensors on the drilling assembly and vehicle record activity, while positioning shows where it happened — so each drilled hole can be recorded with its location.

controller.title: The controller gathers it
controller.body: Signals flow to the onboard controller, which combines location, operating hours and equipment activity into one record.

platform.title: The office sees the field
platform.body: Records reach MingAnji.ai. Office teams see trucks on the map and new drilling locations appear as work is completed.

plan.title: Review, then plan the next job
plan.body: Select mapped drilling locations, check a summary of completed work and export maps, drawings and work information to prepare upcoming tasks.

manage.title: One view for the whole operation
manage.body: Field information feeds management dashboards: truck activity, work progress, staff and timesheets, and business summaries in one place.

closing.title: See it with your own fleet.
closing.body: We'll walk you through MingAnji.ai using the trucks and work you manage.

faq.a1: Each truck connected to MingAnji.ai through its device counts as one vehicle. A truck appears on the map once its device starts sending data.
faq.q2: Can I change my plan later?
faq.a2: Yes. You can move up at any time. If you move to a smaller plan, features outside it lock at the end of your billing period. No data is deleted.
faq.a3: Plans are billed monthly in the currency shown on this page. In Laos you can pay by bank transfer or BCEL QR code. In other countries, our team will confirm the payment method with you.
faq.a4: MingAnji.ai is designed around Tian'An trucks and their sensors and controllers. Contact us to discuss your existing fleet.
faq.q5: Can I see the platform first?
faq.a5: Yes. Request a demo and we'll walk you through MingAnji.ai. Existing customers can sign in to the portal.

faq.what: MingAnji.ai is an intelligent truck monitoring and business management platform, powered by Tian'An. Sensors and controllers on our trucks collect operating information, and MingAnji.ai turns it into maps, dashboards, reports and tools for planning and managing work.
faq.drilling: On drilling trucks, sensors record drilling activity while positioning records where the truck is working. Each recorded hole can then be shown at its location on the MingAnji.ai map, where office teams can review it, select locations and export maps, drawings and work information.
faq.managers: Managers can see truck locations and activity, recorded drilling locations, equipment operating hours, work progress, staff and timesheet summaries, and operational dashboards. Exact screens depend on your configuration.
faq.staff: Yes. MingAnji.ai includes staff management features for staff records, work assignments and timesheets, so people's time can be reviewed alongside field activity. Ask our team which options suit your organisation.
faq.demo: Use the Request a demo button or the Contact us page. Tell us about your trucks and work, and our team will arrange a guided demonstration.
